questions.q: On the book cover 'All Change for the Chans!', what happens to eight-year-old Eric Chan during a storm?
questions.answer: He swaps bodies with his 35-year-old dad, Tony.
options: He turns into a funny dog.
He swaps bodies with his 35-year-old dad, Tony.
questions.explain: 根據書本封面，八歲的 Eric 在暴風雨中與 35 歲的爸爸交換了身體，Eric 要去上班，爸爸卻要去返學。
questions.passage:
Book cover: All Change for the Chans! (Crown Readers, for Primary 4–6)
Written by Michael Hill. Cover illustrated by Glenda Li.
During a storm, eight-year-old Eric Chan swaps bodies with his 35-year-old dad, Tony! Now Eric has to go to work and Dad has to go to school.
'A very funny book!' – Tom Smith, Book Shop Monthly

questions.q: In the notice about after-school classes with 'Clive the Clown', Maggie Lau is in Class 2C. On which day can she have lessons?
questions.explain: 根據通告，小一至小三（Primary 1–3）的課堂在星期一（Mondays 3–4 p.m.），Maggie 讀 2C 班，所以星期一上課。
questions.passage:
After-school classes with Clive the Clown!
Clive is a clown. He makes people happy with jokes, magic tricks, juggling and balloon toys.
Primary 1–3: Mondays, 3–4 p.m.
Primary 4–6: Wednesdays, 3–4 p.m.

questions.q: Look at the contents page of 'Bedtime Stories for Children'. Anne reads: 'Oh dear! She dropped her purse again!' Which story is she reading?
options: Honest Ollie and the Maths Test
questions.explain: 根據目錄簡介，經常粗心掉錢包（dropped her purse again）對應故事《Careless Cathy》。
questions.passage:
Bedtime Stories for Children – Contents
Brave Baby Bear (a little bear is not afraid of the dark) … page 5
Careless Cathy (a girl who always loses her things) … page 13
George the Clever Robot (a robot helps a family) … page 21
Honest Ollie and the Maths Test (a boy makes a hard choice) … page 35
Poor Charlie and the Chocolate Mountain (a boy eats too much chocolate) … page 43
